question.prompt: A bar chart is being drawn for precipitation at a certain location. The maximum data value is 55 (mm), and the vertical axis starts at 0, with each division representing 10 mm. What is the minimum number of divisions needed on the vertical axis to accommodate the maximum value?

solutions.explanation: \(55\div10=5.5\). Even a partial division requires an additional division, so at least 6 divisions are needed.
solutions.title: Calculate the required divisions
